what: AngloGold Ashanti is one of the world's largest gold producers, with mines in Africa, Australia and the Americas. It moved its primary listing to New York and its headquarters out of South Africa.
money: production from mines in Ghana, Tanzania, Australia, Brazil, Argentina and the United States
moat: Large long-life ore bodies, including the Obuasi and Geita mines in West and East Africa, built over more than a century of operating there.
risks: Operations in Ghana, Tanzania, Guinea and Argentina carry political and tax risk
Mining cost inflation has been persistent
Some mines have had operational and grade disappointments
opportunities: Revenue grew about 71% last year and about 30% a year over three years
Return on invested capital of 31% and a 43% operating margin
A dividend yield above 5% with analysts seeing further upside
watch: All-in sustaining cost per ounce and production from its African mines.
